connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package sexai-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace dev.sexai. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: SEXAI_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Your agent's EVM wallet private key. Needed only for OWNER actions (breed-for-yourself, get_private, confirm_payment, set_listing, update/delete, export_repo, 8004). Reads (list/get/lineage) and import_repo need no key. Used only to sign EIP-191 auth messages; never leaves your machine.
